title: Lattice fold, heal, lean workflow

claims.text: When the lattice grows, fold DATA_MODEL and ARCHITECTURE to match code before adding organs.
Agent profile is lean: block first, capped evidence text, symbol-only glyphs, no full neural dumps — saves tokens without losing gates.
Default activate budget is 800 and config context_budget 900; raise only when debug needs depth.
multi_agent mode is off by default; when on, remember and MCP activate/ritual require capability tokens — never host.mutate.
Heal gaps with ARIA memory packets and glyph labels, not new databases or auto-execution.
Efficient loop: immune → interconnect/kernels (compact) → activate lean → remember → ritual seal → metrics.

claim_boundary: Lattice heal packet teaches fold and efficiency; never mutation authority.
